entities.name: PMID:25017997
observations: Rigid high-speed laryngoscopy of nine professional tenors found frequent supraglottic obstruction that limited direct analysis of vocal-fold cycles across modal-to-falsetto or stage-voice transitions.

entities.name: PMID:27499033
observations: In seven tenors, 20,000-fps imaging found changing oscillatory patterns and increased glottal-area open quotient across modal-to-falsetto and modal-to-stage-voice-above-passaggio transitions; falsetto had greater open quotient, without major F0 jumps.

entities.name: PMID:28040341
observations: In six tenors, vowel influenced passaggio oscillation; [aː] was more stable by EGG entropy and phonovibrogram periodicity, and falsetto open quotient exceeded stage voice for [iː] and [uː].

entities.name: PMID:31668917
observations: High-speed imaging of eight professional male singers found stage voice above passaggio more periodic and regular than modal-to-falsetto transitions; increased nasalance stabilized open quotient in four subjects.

entities.name: PMID:33455852
observations: In six tenors, high-speed imaging found falsetto open quotient increased across transition, while stage-voice open quotient varied with loudness and was lower at higher loudness.

entities.name: Tenor passaggio oscillation changes
observations: High-speed laryngeal studies support altered vocal-fold/glottal oscillation across tenor passaggio; open quotient, periodicity, and regularity vary with register strategy, vowel, nasalance, and loudness.
